method.clear_winner_rule: lowest mean moves at both budgets; clustered default-budget 95% paired bootstrap lower bound above zero vs both alternatives; at least 60% of non-tied default comparisons won vs both

decision.reason: Beam has the lowest observed mean at both budgets, but its paired advantage over A* is small, the default-budget clustered 95% interval includes zero, and it won fewer than 60% of non-tied default comparisons. No solver met the predeclared clear-winner rule.
decision.limitation: Comparison uses current implementations and resource settings. A* hit its 25,000-state/open-entry limit in all runs and returned before its full time allowance; changing resource caps could change results.
